tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi bdag 'jug gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa ni 'di yin te/ de la sa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa ni/ 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snga ma rnams sam/ phal cher dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga rdo rje'i 'phreng ba las kyang shes par bya'o/ / 'dir lhag gnas dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang gi bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ mchod gtor la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ i daṃ s+thā naṃ nas/ zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*// gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor na/ khyed kyi bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bcur bzhugs te/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/

gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba/ gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ gtor ma phyi rol tu dor bar bya'o/ /gnas dang mchod pa rnams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du bh+ruṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ oṃ rū pa badz+ra ā ཿhūṃ/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ ra sa/ oṃ spar+sha badz+ra āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we ta badz+ra dharmā hri dā ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzugs sogs ci rigs pa brjod do/ /de nas spro na zhu 'bul bya ste/ spyi dang mthun/ de nas sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te nyer bsdu'i de nyid kyi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i lugs la/ las thig gdab pa yang*/ lha sta gon gyi sngon du byed par bshad pas/ de yan chad ji ltar skabs su bab pa la grub par bya'o/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la sa'i lha mo'i thig le bkod de/

sgos mchod dang gtor ma bshams/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ baṃ las byung ba sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin zhicang*/ g.yas dbang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhi zhing dge la/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po can du gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūṃ gsum/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya sa la reg ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥs 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ sgos mchod kyang sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs pa las/ rol mo byin dbab mi dgos/ 'dod yon lnga'i sngags rnams dor/ oṃ pri thi wī de wi sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar ro/ / skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la*/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ rdo rje nang bsdams kyi phyag rgyas sa de mnan la/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa hūṃ lan gsum/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i dbus kyi hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ dbang chen gyi bar gyi sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍho tiṣ+ṭhaḥ lan gsum/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas so/ /gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang lha gzhan sum cu'i gnas su zlum po re byas la/ me tog gi tshom bu re bkod nas/

mchod gtor rgya cher bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me lce'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang bzang nas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan rnams su gyur gyi bar du sgrub thabs bzhin/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūṃ khaṃ/ le tshe brgyad la/ phyogs bzhir/ oṃ swā a hā/ grwa bzhir laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lha snam gyi shar du maiṃ lhor oṃ oṃ/ nub tu oṃ hūṃ/ byang du oṃ oṃ/ sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhi dang steng 'og rnams su hūṃ re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su zhe sdang rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje'i 'chang du gyur pa ni sku mdog sngon po nas/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de nas lhag mos kyi skabs ltar brjod pa las/ le tshe brgyad la shar du rnam par snang mdzad nas/ don yod grub pa/ shar lhor spyan ma nas/ sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma nas/ ro rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i sogs/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi cod pan can zhes pa la sogs pa cod pan gyi lha rnams brjod pa dor te/ 'og tu gnod mdzes te/ de dag kyang*/ rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar sogs dang*/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar sogs dang*/ 'od dpag med dmar po sogs dang*/ don grub ljang khu sogs dang*/ spyan ma dkar mo sogs dang*/ mā ma kī sngo sogs dang*/ gos dkar mo dmar sogs dang*/ sgrol ma ljang khu sogs dkar mo gzugs kyi sogs/ ser mo sgra yi sogs/ ljang khu ro yi sogs tshigs bcad rnams brjod/ lha'i snam bu la gnas pa'i/ shar gyi g.yas su byams pa dang*/ g.yon du sa'i snying po ste/ gnyis kar rnam par snang mdzad mtshungs/ byams pa'i g.yas na klu shing gi yal ga me tog 'khor los mtshan/

lho yi g.yas su phyag rdor dang*/ /g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /gnyis kar rin chen 'byung ldan mtshungs/ /rin chen dbang po cod pan can/ /nub kyi g.yas su 'jig rten dbang*/ /g.yon du 'jam pa'i rdo rje ste/ /gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dang 'dra/ /'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ /byang gi g.yas su sgrib sel dang*// g.yon phyogs kun tu bzang po ste/ /gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa mtshungs/ / don yod grub pa'i dbu brgyan can/ /gshin rje gshed nag nag dkar dmar sogs/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po ni sogs/ rta mgrin dmar po sogs/ mi g.yo nag po sogs/ 'dod rgyal sngon po sogs/ dbyug sngon sngon po sogs/ stobs chen nag po sogs/ gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba sngo sogs/ gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar sogs/ tshigs bcad rnams mngon rtogs ltar 'don/ sku'i rnam 'gyur lhag ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar yid kyi dran pa tsam bya/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po zhe sdang rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lha so sor rang rang gi spyi bo'i rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi so sor dbang bskur bas/ lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gong du rigs bdag rang chas su ma bskyed na/ skabs 'dir spyi dang mthun par dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur nas/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs byas kyang chog go /de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ gnas yo byin 'bebs kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang bskyed pa'i tshig dor/ 'og nas byung ba ltar mchod yon nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga phyi nang gnyis dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pas kyang bstod de/

de dag ni lha lhag gnas so/ /bum pa legs par bshams te/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa dri shaṃ man+ta hūṃ/ gos zung dang srad bus dkri ba dang kha rgyan gyi sngags so/ / bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin par phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang snying po thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ tap+te tap+te/ mahā tap+te swāhā/ lha'i chu bo dal gyi 'bab pas/ yongs su gang ba rnams su gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan sum cu so gcig la sogs pa lha'i gdan yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du/ hūṃ oṃ swā a hā zhes pa nas/ gnod mdzes rgyal po bskyed pa yan chad kyi bar/ lha sta gon skabs dang 'dra ba las/ le tshe brgyad la zhes pa dor nas/ shar du rnam snang sogs brjod/ rim pa gnyis pa 'i zhes pa dang*/ lha snam zhes pa dor nas/ de'i phyi rol shar lhor sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol shar gyi g.yas su sogs brjod/ shar sgor sogs dang*/ shar lho'i grwar sogs dor nas/ shar du zhes sogs brjod/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba yang*/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ / las bum gyi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bgegs mthar byed pa sngo sangs ni/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum pa/ rgya gram 'khor lo gtun shing g.yas/ /thugs dkar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /rgyal ba rnga sgra'i cod pan can/ /spyan gsum sbom thung dbu skra brdzes/ / mche gtsigs sbrul rgyan stag lpags can/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bgegs mthar byed kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ mchod pa rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs te/ las rgyal mchog gi skabs ltar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ut+ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bum bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ lha thams cad kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i sngags ci mang du bzla zhing 'khor rnams kyi bdun bdun tsam bzla/ las bum la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta krita hūṃ/ brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rtsa sngags kyang cung zad bzlas te/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i rtsa sngags ring thung gang bzlas kyang 'dra/ ring ba le'u bcu bzhi pa nas gsungs pa ni 'di yin te/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra nāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃ ṣ+tod ka ṭa bhe ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pa sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha/ tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭā ya bi s+pho ṭā ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya kā na/ ga na pa ti dzi bi ta/ an+ta ka ra ya swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /mngon rtogs ltar gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ lha tshogs rnams la gtor sngags kyis phul/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la rtsa sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas kyang phul la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/

gtso bo'i snying po lan bdun dang*/ hūṃ bdun bzlas/ dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung gang rung zhig bzla bzhin du/ me tog dkar po gsum gsum gzhug las bum gyi chu ku shas blangs nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rtsa sngags bzla bzhin du/ bum pa dang bdag nyid dang*/ gnas khang la bsang gtor bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs kyi bar du/ bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig cesabarjod/ yang na skabs 'dir/ gtor ma 'bul bar bshad pa'i lugs yod pa bzhin byas kyang rung la/ las bum gyi lha mi zhu ba'i lugs kyang yod pa/ spyir de dag gang gi lugs ltar byas kyang mi 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /bum pa lhag gnas so/ /de nas las rgyal mchog gi skabs ltar/ bstod pa dang mchod pa dang nang mchod 'bul ba rnams byas la/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /thugs rje yi ni bdag can bdag /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed cag la yang mchod slad du/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'dri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni/ /de phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /rdo rje can bdag ch+gai mos/ /gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ni/ /cho ga ci nus yo byad kyis/ /sang ni yang dag 'dri bar 'gyur/ /de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /'khor bcas kun gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /

zhes gsol ba btab/ lha tshogs thams cad kyis kyang snang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de yan chad nyi ma gcig la byed cing*/ de'i nang bar thig tshon gyi cho ga byed pa yin na/ lhag gnas kyi nub mchod pa bzang du phul la/ nang par rjes chog byas te ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa yin la/ snga dro lhag gnas byas shing*/ phyi dro dkyil 'khor 'dri ba sogs cho ga myur bar bya dgos pa'i skabs yin na/ gsol gdab byas ma thag tu rjes chog bya ste/ ras bris kyi cho ga la yang 'di bzhin du byas la/ nang par thig tshon gyi cho ga byed rgyu yin yang*/ rjes chog gi skabs 'di nyid du byas na lag len bde zhing*/ de ltar byed pa la 'gal ba cung zad kyang med pas/ ji ltar spro ba de ltar bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ mchod ba rnying pa gsos shing gsar du'ang bshams/ bsangs sbyangs lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshigs bcad spyi 'gro dang bcas pa'am/ tshigs bcad med kyang rung ste/ las rgyal mchog nas byung ba'i sngags kyis phul/ snying po rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ de nyid lnga pa dang bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la btegs/ slar yang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zung 'jug sum cu rtsa gnyis lha/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ gis bsrung ngo*/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la/ ye thig gdab pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi bya ba gnyis so/ / dang po ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ tshon skud sna lnga/ yungs kar gyi phye ma dang*/

bdud rtsi lnga bsres pas byugs/ dri zhim pos bgos la nag dkar ser dmar ljang khu lnga po rim pas mthe bong sogs kyi rtsa bar bkod nas/ cung zad brkyang ste/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud nag po/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam snang gi ngo bo/ aṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ dz+riṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu don grub kyi ngo bo rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams baṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs/ oṃ a ak+ṣo bh+yaḥbadz+ra su traṃ me pra yats+tsha/ mahā maṇ+ḍal sū tra ṇa ya hūṃ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de bzhin du ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ 'i gnas su sha shwa ta dang*/ rat+na saṃ bha wa dang*/ a mi ta bha dang*/ a mo gha sid+dhi zhes pa rnams bcug te gsol ba btab/ rang gi mig gnyis su dzaḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can/ mig 'bras hūṃ/ oṃ dīp+ta driṣ+ta aṃ ku sha dzaḥ nam mkha'i lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gsal ba dang/ lhan cig thig skud brkyang ste/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba ngharmā pa ras pa ra/ a nu pra briṣ+ta sarba dharmā/ ar+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ta/ sarba ngharma oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dang por so sor sgril/ de nas phyogs gcig tu sgril lo/ /thig skud kyang lnga tshan lngar byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nyid snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ badz+ra driṣ+ti ma ṭa/ thig skud la drag tu bltas pas brtan par byas la/

las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang/ yungs kar dang dri bzang gi chus gtor lag pas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tra hūṃ dang/ oṃ āḥhūṃ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas so/ /las thams cad pas bsrung ba byas nas bzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ/ zhes dri bzang gi chus gtor/ bye dor bya/ mtha' la me tog bkram/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pas/ lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ slob ma nub tu phyogs pa la g.yas pas thig sna gtad/ dz+dzaḥ zhes brjod/ slob mas g.yon pas blangs la lte bar bzung*/ de nas ji ltar gdab pa ni/ thig 'dzin tshul de nyid las/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi thig skud nam mkhar 'degs pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ hūṃ oṃ swā a hā/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir byon cig /thig gi sgras/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te/ mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thig skud la thim/ de yang*/ nub shar gnas pas tshangs thig dang po btab/ /lho byang gnyis pa me dbang shar gyi logs/ /rlung srin nub dang rlung dbang byang yin te/ /me srin gnas pas lho yi rtsa thig gdab/ /srin dbang zur thig dang po me rlung nas/ /zur thig gnyis pa btab ste thig chen brgyad/ /ces pa ltar g.yas bskor dang 'gros sogs lag len bzhin bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma ho zhes pas thig bteg ste/ slob dpon nang du zhugs/ hi hi zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang bcas pas/ sgo'i thad gyi rtsa thig dbye/ thig skud la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ tshon sna lnga'am nyi shu rtsa lnga legs par bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs thig skud ces pa'i gnas su

rdul tshon zhes pa dang*/ badz+ra sū traṃ zhes pa'i gnas su/ badz+ra tsi traṃ dang sū tra ṇa ya 'i gnas su/ tsi tra ṇa ya zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs ye thig dang 'dra mig g.yas pa ma zhes pa nas/ brtan par byas kyi bar yang rdul tshon zhes pa nyid khyad par ro/ / oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla zhing mtheb srin gyis mnye/ rdul tshon rnams la hi yig bris te/ bden pa gang gi sems can rnams rdul mang zhing*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod la yid kyis mchod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyi dbus kyi phur bu phyung*/ ye shes pa lag pa'i rdo rje la thim/ phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyis 'gengs bzhin du dril bu dkrol la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ / zhes pa'i don dran bzhin du glu blang ngo*/ /de nas ci bder 'gyed de bum pa brgyad kyang 'dri/ lha'i gdan dang mtshan ma rnams ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs la brtags pas shes/ 'on kyang da lta'i sgrub thabs mdor byas las/ gshin rje gshed kyi phyag mtshan dbyug pa dang*/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa pa tshab 'gyur las tho bar bshad pa cung zad ma mthun yang*/ lugs 'di la/ gdam khar khas len dgos pas/ ji ltar 'os pa 'dri'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor cho ga nyi shu pa las/ 'dod rgyal dang gnod mdzes la zhags pa/ gzhan mtshams kyi khro bo gsum la ral gri/ gtsug tor la lag pa'i phyag rgya'i gzugs dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan ma la spyan 'bras 'dri ba sogs lha mo bzhi la rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar bshad pa ltar yang rung mod kyi lag pa'i phyag rgya dang spyan 'bras kho na 'dri ba da lta mi mdzes pas/

'khor lo mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa dang*/ gtsug tor la yang 'khor lo nyid bris na legs so// rgyan dang mchod pa bkram pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ bum pa 'god tshul yang rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yon dang*/ las bum g.yas su 'god do/ /lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ de'i 'god tshul yang dgos mod kyi 'dir ma bshad do/ /ras bris kyi cho ga la ni thig tshon gyi bya ba ni ye mi dgos la/ bum pa 'god tshul de yang mtha' cig tu mi dgos so/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rdzogs kyi bar du bya dgos la/ las rgyal mchog yongs rdzogs bsgoms kyang rung bar ni mngon la/ mchod pa dang nyer bsdu tsam las/ gzhan gsal por ma bshad pas/ de tsam gyi kyang chog ste/ bdag bskyed kyi rim pa'o// de nas las thams cad pa'i chus dkyil 'khor la bsangs shing*/ yi ge gsum mang du bzlas la rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan rnams su gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid gnas par gyur te/ dbus kyi lha'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gzugs su gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang rigs kyi phyag rgya sprul/ reg bya rdo rje ma'i mtshan ma dang ro cig tu 'dres/ bdag nyid oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ du gyur/ le tshe brgyad la/ shar du oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor oṃ āḥswa hūṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ las 'od dpag med/ byang du oṃ āḥhā hūṃ las don yod grub pa/ shar lhor oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lho nub tu oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ las mā ma kā+-i/

nub byang du oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ las gos dkar mo/ byang shar du oṃ āḥtaṃ hūṃ las sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar lhor oṃ āḥdzaḥhūṃ las gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du oṃ āḥhoḥhūṃ las ro rdo rje ma/ dbus kyi reg bya rdo rje ma'i lha'i mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo'i pang du oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma/ lha rnams gyi mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar gyi g.yas su oṃ āḥmai+aiṃ hūṃ las byams pa/ g.yon du oṃ āḥ hūṃ las sa'i snying po/ lho'i g.yas dang g.yon du oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ las g.yas su phyag rdor/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po/ nub kyi g.yas su oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon du oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ las 'jam dpal/ byang gi g.yas dang g.yon du oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ las g.yas/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po/ sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhi dang steng 'og gi mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ zhes pa bcur gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgor rta mgrin/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams su gyur/ de dag kyang 'di ltar/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po nas/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar nas/ gnod mdzes kyi tshigs bcad rdzogs kyi bar/ lha lhag gnas kyi skabs ltar 'don zhing don yid la dran par bya'o/ de nas rgyas par na/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ zhes pa nas/ gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams bzhugs par gyur

gyi bar dang*/ yum gyi spyi bor oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad ces pa nas/ sa 'dzin lha mo rnams su gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin sgom bsdu na/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte ba swā ser po/ brla'i rtsa ba hā ljang khu/ zhes pa tsam brjod/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje zhes pa nas/ lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs rnams dang lhan cig thig ler zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas pad+ma babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le cha sum cu so gnyis su gyur/ de rnams hūṃ oṃ swā a hā laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ mai+aiṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra ngh+rika dzi na dzaka zhes pa nas/ suṃ bha rā dza 'i bar 'byin sngags sum cu so gnyis phyogs gcig tu brjod nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du so so'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can tham cad kyi phung po lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ dbang po dang yul dang nye bar 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga dang yon tan gyi phyogs tshad med pa la bkod/ sprul pa rnams phan tshun du 'dus lha sum cu so gnyis su gyur/ gdod nas grub pa'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par 'dres shing*/ rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs nas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi slar yang 'byon par bzhed cing*/ sbyan 'dren pa la nye bar bzhes pa'i tshul du yang dag par gnas par gyur/ dam tshig sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa gnyis po rnams dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad kyi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/

de rnams kyi thugs karating nge 'dzin sems dpa' rang rang gi sa bon gyi rnam par brgyan par gyur/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa la sogs pa dam tshig pa/ lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa spraus ye shes pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi thugs kar reg cing bskul bas gnad du bsnun par gyur/ gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa zhig byung ste rang gi mdun du bka' nod phyir gnas pa la/ kyai khro bo sems can rnams la dbang bskur ba'i don du rgyal ba rnams 'byon par bskul zhig gnod mdzes dpag tu med pas/ ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang spyan drangs/ e h+ye hi bha ga wān sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ra/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ma nu sma ra sma ra/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ de nas ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūṃ sogs 'dod yon lngas mchod/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang 'byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza dza dza/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang ro mnyam du gyur par mos la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

lan sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ lha so so rang rang gi spyi bo nas/ rang bzhin du gyur zhes brjod pas dbang bskur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ lan bdun tsam/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan mang du brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon yab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka ra ar+thaṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ lha yi me tog dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āḥpuṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de nyid 'don pa spo ste/ rol mo/ shap+ta zhes bya ba'i bar du sbyar ro/ /gos zung spyi dang mthun par phul/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sa snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /rū pa/ yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs/ /de bzhin sgra la dbye ba gsum/ /sgra yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /phyag rdor la ni dbul bar bya// shap+ta/ ga pur a kar dzā ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri la dbye ba gsum/ /dri yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /nam snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /gan+dhe/ 'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang*/ /ro drug de bzhin dbye ba gsum/ /ro yi rdo rje mar bkug nas// 'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul/ /rā sa/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /'khyud dang gos sogs dbye ba gsum/ /reg bya'i rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sgrib sel la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /spar+she/ phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /brtags pa dang ni ma brtags pa/ /chos dbyings rdo rjer yang dag bkug

/'jam pa'i rdo rje la ni dbul/ /dharmā dhā tu/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la nang mchod 'bul/ lha rnams kyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sgos kyi chos skyong yod na/ de dang de'i snying po'i mthar/ yi ge 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa= gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi= gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig mkha' gsang byin rlabs nas/ rjes chags kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i bar/ gsang ba'i mchod pa yang sgrub thabs bzhin 'bul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing*/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ /sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing*/ /byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sgrib med 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// phun tshogs bde ba bskyod mdzad ma/ /lha mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*/ /mi zad mngon shes yon tan ldan/ /sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*/ /stobs bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag /zhi sogs las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i/ khrol rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*/ /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ /sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ bar 'dir bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ sgrub thabs bzhin bzlas pa rigs gnyis ci 'grub tu bya zhing*/ mthar yi ge brgya pa'ang mang du bzla'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsrung ba bzhag la/ phyi rol tu 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin dgos te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa'ang 'bru gsum la bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ bkra shis mdzad du gsol swāhā 'i bar dang*/ zhing skyong la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa'i/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes pa nas/ bzod gsol gyi bar du sgrub thabs kyi 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ bar der dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad la 'phrin las gzhol zhing*/ bsrung ba mdzad par zhus/ 'byung po spyi rnams dengs shig ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor ma dor/ tsham rngam dang drag rol bya/ nang du 'ongs te sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs bya'o/ /hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa mā ya pra bai sha ya hūṃ/

zhes phyogs bzhi nas sgo bzhi dbye'o/ /bzhi pa dbang gi bya ba la bdag nyid gzhug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ dang*/ las bum gyi chus bsangs/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha ba ra ma na ya hūṃ/ oṃ dngos grub kun gyi grong khyer nyams dga' ba// thar ba'i grong du 'jig rten bde chen 'jug /mchog gi bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod swāhā/ zhes pa'i mig dar bcing zhing me tog bzung*/ kyai rab dga' la dga' ba khyed su/ bde chen bdag ni skal pa bzung*/ / zhes brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u ba da ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya stāṃ/ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes nang gi sems bskyed bya/ 'on kyang nang gi sems bskyed 'di nyid nyi shu pa dang 'jug gsal gnyis kar na mi snang bas/ nyi shu pa'i lugs la ma byas kyang chog par mngon no/ / ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ yol ba'i nang du bcug oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa s+tha nā ya/ ād+ma naṃ nir+yā tad+yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā tad+yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta na ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā tad+yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā pra warta ya maṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe āt+ma naṃ nir+yā tad+yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maṃ/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung*/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ slob dpon gyi phyag rgya de nyid spyi bor bzhag par mos la/

oṃ satwa badz+ri a nghi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ hūṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ta re/ phyag rgya de nyid snying gar gtugs te/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bsngags pa'i dung gi chu btung*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal pa'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra uta da ka ṭha/ der phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyi nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa rnams dam bzhag go / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ bdag nyid langs te gnas pa/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar khong stong du gyur pa'i/ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu dbyibs can/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po grub gsum/ de nyid rab tu 'bar ba'i steng rkang mthil du dzhaiḥdamar po/ rlung g.yos me spar dzhaiḥlas 'od zer 'bar rang lus 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs/

de las rang nyid 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhengs pa/ rlung me bskul sngags kyi yi ge dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ snying gar hūṃ las thugs rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje'i 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ mgo bor ha las sku rdo rje dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ de rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mi bskyod par gsal pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ gnas gsum na gnas pa'i rdo rje gsum la thim/ yang rlung g.yos me sbar dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi lus nang khyab par bskul bas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs pas lus gang bar gyur/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya snying gar gtad la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang*/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /de nyid khyod la 'bebs par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ.aḥ.aḥ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas par bya/ gal te des ma phebs na/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i lus thams cad a yig dmar po'i 'od zer gyis gang bar bsam nas/ yi ge gsum dang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi byang chub kyi sems 'bebs pa sogs snga ma ltar byas nas/ ye shes pa a yig dmar po'i rnam pa char ltar babs par bsam/ a bhe sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūṃ ha a dzhaiḥ zhes drag tu bzla ba yin te/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su spogs chog 'di mi dgos so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa bzla ba bzhin du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par byas par mos/ slob ma la dbang bskur na bar 'dir/ nam mkha'i kha dog kyang 'dri/ spro na spyi dang mthun par bden stobs kyang brjod de/

skabs 'dir mi dgos/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wā/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid dhi me pra yats+tsha hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ oṃ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ pra tīts+tsha ku mu ma añtsa li nā thā ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā bā la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcings te/ de ni dbang dang po me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ngo*/ / snying gar hūṃ/ dpral bar baṃ/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ re re/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ / ces mig dar dkrol/ de ring dang pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ /he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sku la gnas pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag kyang mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus na/ skabs 'dir lha ngo rgyas par ston/ de nas rten dang brten pa'i de nyid ni/ ye shes kyi snang ba'i me ri/ bgegs kyis mi phyed pa rdo rje'i khor yug rdo rje gsum dag pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ skyon gyis ma gos pas pad+ma/ lta ba ngan pa 'joms shing ye shes lnga dag pas sna tshogs rdo rje/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang ngo*/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ngos bzhir 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'i grwa yin no/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po zhes bya ba/ /re re bsgo bzhi zhes bya ste/ /chos kyi de nyid don gyi brda/ /'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de ni/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /phung po lnga dag pa'i sangs rgyas lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi dag pas yum bzhi/ 'dod yon lnga dag pas rdo rje ma lnga/ mig sogs brgyad dag pas byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/

lag sogs lus kyi cha shes bcu dag pas khro bo bcu'o/ / bsdu na rten dang brten pa'i de nyid brjod pa 'di bdag 'jug gi skabs su ma byas kyang chog go /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na/ mngon rtogs ltar lus dkyil yang mdor bsdus su brjod do/ /de nas bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ skad cig tsam gyis khrus kyi khang pa dbang stegs dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs sngags bzla zhing*/ las bum gyi chu gtor la/ gnas dang gang zag dbang stegs yo byad thams cad bsangs te de dag ni bum dbang gi sngon 'gro'o/ / rang nyid khrus kyi khang par zhugs te/ dbang stegs kyi gdan la gnas par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ mi bskyod nag po nag dkar

zhes pa nas/ sems dpa'i cod pan can gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma khro bo'i dbang po'i tshogs dang bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ / 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la gnang bar mdzod/ / ces dbang gi lha la lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lhas shis pa brjod pa ni/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /sdang bas zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa/ /mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yi ni/ /bkra shis des ni= /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing*/ /rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo yongs su skyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni= /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ /'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dgrol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing*/ khengs pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su spyod mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni=

/bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ / chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni= / bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spyod/ /de spyod thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / zhes so/ /de nas bum pa thogs te/ til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i/ /rgyal ba bum pa 'dzin pa yis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /de ltar shes nas yid bder byos/ / bum pa'i kha rgyan gyis bum chu spyi bo nas gtor la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe na u pa ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ zhes dbang bskur te khrus bya/ khrus zin pa na ched du brjod pa'i tshul du/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ āḥbadz+ra u ta ka abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+wāṃ a haṃ/ de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ / chu dbang ngo*/ /de nas bdag nyid dbang stegs las babs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'jam pa'i gtan la 'dug cing gos dmar po bgos par gyur/ swa bhā wa/ dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag nas/ rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur/

dbang rdzas rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ spyi bor gdugs dkar po bzung la me tog gtor/ 'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /rdo rje chen po nor chen po/ /shes rab chen po ye shes che/ /rdo rje sems dpar deng bdag sgrub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde stsol ba/ / kun gyi dbang bskur bskur don du/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bla na med/ /e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal/ /chos 'dod nor dang thar pa ster mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes lnga ldan dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal/ /mgon po rdau rje phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ / zhes ched du brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum du byas te/ slar yang gdan la 'dug par mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ / zhes sogs kyi dbu rgyan mgo la bcings/ rdo rje ma lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas spyi bo/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su gtugs/ mthar thal mo brdabs pas dga' ba bskyed de/ de dag gi sngags ni/ oṃ badz+rā dhā twi shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ satwa badz+rā a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+ruṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ ngharmā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ oṃ karma badz+rā a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ badz+rā tu ṣ+ya ho/ sngags de nyid kyis dar dpyangs yang bcing ngo*/ /dbu rgyan bcing ba la/ sngags gzhan ma gsungs pas mi dgos so/ / de nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ka sogs/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ sngar bzhin brjod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi/ nga rgyal dang ser sna/ tshor ba'i phung po/ mnyam pa nyid ky-i/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur te/ cod pan gyi dbang ngo*/ / swa bhā wa/ dbang rdzas rdo rje/ āḥdang pad+ma/ 'od dpag med dmar nas/ rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par/

'od dpag med zhu ba la/ rdo rjer/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ / rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje bzung*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /dngos grub mchog phyir rdo rje long*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi khyed la stsol/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya staṃ/ zhes rdo rje lag tu bzung*/ gnas gsum du gtugs nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar bzhag /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag pa'i bdag /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje brtul zhugs dang*/ rdo rje thugs kyi de nyid kyang 'dir bzung*/ gong bzhin bum chus dbang bskur la/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan/ 'od dpag med rdo rje/ 'dod chags*/ 'du shes/ sor rtog ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi zhes te rdo rje'i dbang ngo*/ / swa bhā wa/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ ha dang ral gri las/ don grub ljang khu nas/ rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ don yod grub pa'i rnam par/ don yod grub pa zhu ba las/ dril bur/ zla ba'i 'od can ye shes sku mdangs rgyal ba'i cod pan 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i don du srid gsum 'dul mdzad sdigs pa'i de nyid rdo rje can/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bskul phyir de kho na nyid so sor sgrog pa'i chos nyid dril bu 'khrol/ dngos po kun gyi ngo bo ma lus stong pa'i bcom ldan gang yin de ni rgyal gyur cig me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang*/

/rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang*/ /mig 'phrul 'dra bar gang mthong ba/ /de ni mnga' bdag du bshad do/ / zhes lag pa g.yon du gtad pas/ des kyang dkrol te dku g.yon pa'i phyogs su bkan te bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje snyems pa'i tshul gyis bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+ri bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa a/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ bdag gis bcom ldan bzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la nye bar mdzod/ / ces brjod do/ /slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra mi/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dril bu'i de kho na nyid kyang bzung*/ gong bzhin chus dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ don yon grub pa dril bu'i/ phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba sgrub pa/ don yod grub pa'i zhes te dril bu'i dbang ngo*/ / swa bhā wa/ bdag dang dbang rdzas me long*/ hūṃ dang rdo rje las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ mig thur āḥlas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ gsum kar yang sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhu ba las/ mig thur dang me long du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ / mig thur ro/ / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/

/ sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sras su skye/ /sngar bzhin bum chus dbang bskur/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan/ /me long gi dbang bskur pas rdo rje sems dpa' snying la zhugs shing gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rnam par dag pa yin no/ / me long gi dbang ngo*/ / swa bhā wa/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ dang 'khor lo las/ rnam snang dkar po nas/ rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad ky-i rnam par/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon bla gos kyi grwa bzung nas/ lung bstan par bsam la/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan bya/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rdo rje dril bu spyi bor gtugs te/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta kyai dpal ch+gai mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa ma ya sid dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur bhu ba swaḥ.aḥ gsang mtshan dran par bya/ bum chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi gti mug gzugs kyi phung po/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa bsgyur te ming gi dbang ngo*/ /'dir 'jug gsal las/ chu dbang rnam snang dang*/ ming dbang mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas bskur bar bshad la/ de ltar spyi ldog nas rung srid kyang*/ bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng las mi bskyod pa'i gsung ba nyid dbang btsan par bya'o/ / shar sgor dbang stegs rin po che'i khri mchod pa'i sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i steng du/

bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i skur gyur/ rang snang ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus yang dag par 'khyud pa las/ bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu brjod/ / oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /dza ya dza ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti pra warta ya/ ngharma tsakra/ swa las byung ba'i rin po che/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo/ sems can kun la sogs tshig rkang gsum 'dra/ sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu ston/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba ngharmāḥsu bi shung+ngha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe ka prasta oṃ oṃ oṃ/ hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo can/ sems can kun la sogs/ 'dod chags dag pa rab tu ston/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sarba dharma su bi shud+dha dz+nyā na rā ga pad+ma da la swa bhā wa hrīḥ.aḥhā las byung ba'i rdo rje rkyang pa'am/ rdo rje rgya gram don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sems can kun la sogs/ rdo rje mchod pa rab tu bskor/ oṃ badz+ra karmaḥsarba dharmas su bi shud+dha dz+nyā naḥ sarba pū dza swa bha wa aḥ de nas/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ / zhes sogs slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrags pa nyid kyis slob dpon gyi dbang 'di nyid kyi rang lugs thob par 'gyur te/ nyi shu pa las de kho na gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang dkyil chog spyi dang mthun pa'i phyir dang*/ 'jug gsal gyi cung zad kha skong par spro na/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ / zhes sogs dang*/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ / zhes sogs kyi don bshad nas/ lha sku kha sbyor gyi bde ba la sems 'dzin du bcug cing*/

slar yang bum pa'i chus sngon bzhin dbang bskur te/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu rgyan pa dang*/ puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sogs kyis brtan gzhugs bya/ khyod kyi srog chags gsad bar bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*/ /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de phyir sangs rgyas 'bras 'dod cing*/ /gus dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi/ /bsam yas 'bras bu stsol ba po/ /'di la 'bad pa kun gyis mchod/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig sgrub/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ / rtag tu bla ma la yang 'bul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /shes rab thabs kyi sems kyis ni/ /mi bya cung zad yod ma yin/ /rtag tu rnam rtog med gyur nas/ khyod kyi 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthun gsungs shing*/ /bka' lung dam pa rtag pa yi/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /

zhes te/ phyag mtshan gyi dbang zhes kyang bya ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas/ na bza' dang mchod pa bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlab pa'am yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a nut+ta ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yid kyi sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod/ spro na sngags dang phyags rgya dang*/ tshigs bcad dbyangs la sogs pas kyang 'bul lo/ /de nas slob dpon la yon phul bar mos te/ mi zad de nyid 'dod pa yi/ cung zad yid 'ongs gang dang gang*/ /shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /de de bla ma la 'bul bya/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes bla med thob par 'gyur/ /swa bhā wa/ oṃ dang 'khor lo las byung ba'i bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur/ de la gtso bos rjes su gnang bstsal ba ni/ phreng ba la sogs dbang rnams kyi/ /dbang bskur nga yis byin pa 'dis/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdun na gnas/ /da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsams/ khyod ni bdud rnams las rgyal te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /seng ge'i spyod pa legs spyad pas/ khyod kyis sems can don rnams byos/ /chos rnams kun la ser sna dang*/ /sems can rnams la mi phan gang*/ /nyam nga shin tu che na yang*/ /bu khyod kyis ni de mi byed/ /de la the tshom mi bya ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /mnyam med khyod kyis bsgrags par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bya ste/ /slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /slob ma rnams la dbang bskur gyis/

/brtul zhugs brtan pas 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrubs/ /de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ /dam tshig rnams ldan bskyangs pa dang*/ khyod rtag bla ma la gus pas/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes te/ rjes su gnang bas dbang bskur ba'o/ / de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram/ phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor lus dkyil dang lhan cig tu bum dbang yan lag dang bcas pa thun mong gi dbang dgu thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par sgrigs pa yin no/ / gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /yang dag gsang ba'i dbang bskur ni/ /snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha sogs kyis mig dar bcing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i sku la thim/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ stong pa bzhi'i ye shes lhan cig skyes pa brtan par byas/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu la gnas pa mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs nas/ lce steng du phab/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi myangs/ byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa dri bzang dang sbyar te/ thod pa'am dung chos su blugs te dbang bskur/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la sogs shis brjod sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/

ji ltar 'das pa'i nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ spyi bor gtor nas/ lce thog tu bzhag de gnyis kar gyi mthar/ a ho mahā su khaṃ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mig dar phye/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel legs par sgrigs pa yin no/ / shes rab ye shais kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab gsang dbang dang 'dra ba las/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba/ zhes 'don pa spo/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di yis dag /de phyir 'di dang bral ba ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yod med do/ / de nas/ des kyang chu skyes gsal bar byas te/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun du bdag gnas te/ / sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bhañdza mo k+ṣa ho/ bdag dang rig ma rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum du gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las nas 'dab ma brgyad pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ snang ba gsum gyi rim pa'i mthar 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byed par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ mig dar dkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel legs par sgrigs pa yin no/ / dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de bzhin rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ 'di la mig dar bcing dkrol mi dgos/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ / de bzhin du/ de nyid shes pas rim pa bzhin/ /rang byin rlabs dang 'od gsal ba/ /de dag kho na 'dus pa gang*/ /'di ni zung 'jug rim pa'o/ /de ltar na 'od gsal dang*/ sgyu ma'i sku zung du 'jug pa/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid do/ / zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhag go / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi ba thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag lam zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ / sogs lan gsum mo// de nas slob la gzhug pa'i don du/ dril stabs dang*/ thal mo sbyar bas/ bden stobs brjod cing gsol ba gdab ste/ de yang*/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni dpe yang ste/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang mtshungs/ /bden pa 'di yis slob ma rnams/

/thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu gzhug /'khor lo rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa/ /mthong na sdig pa mtha' dag spongs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa/ / snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ /dam tshig dran par byas pa las/ /bzhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ bar 'dir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma nang gtor rnams 'bul bar bya ste/ sgrub thabs kyi mjug tu bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa slob ma dbang bskur ba la/ slob ma sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ / zhes sogs kyis mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed/ de bzhin du nang dbang bskur ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ sngags la spro ba bskyed pa/ phyi nang gi sdom pa bzung ba/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ so shing dor ba/ khyor chu byin pa/ ku sha gtod pa/ bsrung skud bcing ba rnams spyi dang 'dra ste khyad par du yang*/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o/ /zab cing rgya che zhes bshad pa/ /rnam par rtog med zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don/ /phye ste so sor shes nas su/ /de nas gcig tu 'dres byas pa'i/ /zag med go 'phang thob par bya/ /de yi kun tu kun las byung*/ /rnam kun kun tshe rang nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rang bzhin du/ / grub par rang nyid kyis mthong 'gyur/ /byang chub sus kyang byin ma yin/

/su yis kyang ni bzung ma yin/ /rang chos yongs su shes pa las/ /de la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas brjod/ /sems can bag la nyal dbye bas/ /yang dag mgon pos de nyid ni/ /'bad pas sbas nas phung po yi/ /rin chen za ma tog tu bzhag /de phyir bla ma'i zhal gyi ni/ /drin gyis 'bad pas rtogs bya ste/ /de nyid kyis yang gsal gyur pa/ /de nas spyod pa rab tu bya/ /'di la gtsang sbra nges sdom med/ /dka' thub med cing dka' spyad med/ /dka' ba med cing nges med la/ /bde ba bsten pas 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod pa ni/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa'i bshad pa'i khyad par te/ 'on kyang rnam snang mngon byang las 'byung ba bzhin brjod kyang rung bas skabs 'dir gdam kha yin la/ gnyis kar brjaud dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de rjes rmi lam brtag cing*/ ngan na bsrung ba yang sbyi dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'jug pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba yang*/ gong du bstan pa'i bdag 'jug 'don pa spos pa nyid kyi chog cing*/ lag len mthong ba brgyud pa las shes la/ khyad par du yang lag len dang mtshams sbyor ba rnams dbang chog spyi'i go ba chags pa zhig gi rigs pas brtags pas 'bad med du shes par 'gyur la/ spyir slob dpon mkhas pa la dri gtugs nan tan byed pa gal che'o/ /dbang gi bya ba rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ 'grub na zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg gis lha mnyes par bya/ yo byad med na bsam gtan gyis sbyin bsreg tsam bya zhing*/ de yang bya long ma byung na/ gtor ma phul bas kyang mnyes par bya'o/ / bzhi pa mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'am rjes chog ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams shing rnying pa gso/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ chu gnyis nyer sbyod tshigs bcad dang bcas pa dang*/ nang mchod dang gsang mchod dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin phul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/

khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ nus mthu'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de ring bzod par gsol/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun gtso bos bzod mdzod rigs/ / bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha skong zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi las dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa stsal/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir// rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra muḥ zhes bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing bstim pa'i lha tshogs la ma gtogs pa'i mgron thams cad gshegs su gsol/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na/ bar 'dir brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ de nas gtso bo don dam la zhugs pa nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar du sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i/

las rgyal mchog gi skabs ltar/ tshang bar sgom ste/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ rang nyid la thim pa'i bar ro/ /'di la lha tshogs rang la bsdu ba'i skabs/ lus dkyil gyi skabs sam/ lhag mos rang la bsdu ba'i skabs bzhin yid kyis sgom la/ mchod bstod kyang don la bsam gtan kho nas bya ba yin zhing*/ deng sang chog sgrigs ngag 'don byed pa la yang*/ phyag rgya dang rol mo dang*/ dngos su nang mchod/ myang ba sogs mi byed pa lag len no/ /de nas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs dang*/ a kā ro 'i sngags 'bru gsum dang bcas pas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol byed cing*/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs/ phur bu phyug zhing bkru/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs ci 'grub bya ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel mar byed na mgron rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes su/ las rgyal mchog gi mchod pa song*/ dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par sems can thams cad la byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur/ de rnams rang la bstim/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las gtso bo gnyis pa zhig chad de mdun du 'dug par mos/ gzugs brnyan kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ de dag ni ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la yang 'dra ste/ de la ni de'i rjes su smon lam dang bkra shis kho na bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin na nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad nas/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub lugs kyi khyad par nyi ma dang po dang mi 'dra ba byed dgos pas/ skabs 'dir yang mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams bsgyur mi dgos kyang*/ 'dir nang par nas kyang sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren pa ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga sngar bshad pa kho na ltar byed pa lag len du snang bas/ lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams su gyur zhes brjod/ de nas smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/

/dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa yi/ /man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ /lugs 'di shin tu grags che la/ /lugs 'di'i dbang gi cho ga yang*/ /rtsa ba mi 'dra rnam gsum yod/ /phyis dus bod kyi mkhas pa kun/ /klu byang lugs su grags 'di la/ /brtsis su mdzad phyir 'dir bris te/ /gzhung gi dgongs don ji bzhin las/ /rang nyid yid dga'i kha skongs kyis/ /zab zab ltar bcos ma byas zhing*/ /'dus gsal snying po 'gral par bkod/ /'di las dge ba gang thob des/ /bla med byang chub rtag pa'i gnas/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob gyur te/ /'gro ba kun yang der 'god shog

/gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags bskor gyi bdag 'jug 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'gro ba mang po la phan par gyur cigamaṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 74--PAGE 73--PAGE 34- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
